action.command:
cat > /workspace/taki-config.yaml <<'EOF'
listen: ":9998"

llm:
  api_base: "http://your-llm:8012/v1"
  model: "local"
  max_tokens: 4096

collabora:
  url: "http://collabora:9980"

whisper:
  api_base: ""
  model: "whisper-large-v3"

embedding:
  api_base: ""
  model: "nomic-ai/nomic-embed-text-v1.5"

pdf:
  dpi: 150
  max_pages: 20

fallback:
  min_chars: 200
  min_chars_per_page: 50

routing:
  vector: always
  bleve_rules:
    - match:
        mime: ["application/pdf", "application/msword", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-*"]
      features: [meta, entities, summary]
    - match:
        mime: ["application/vnd.ms-excel", "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml*"]
      features: [meta]
    - match:
        mime: ["message/*"]
      features: [meta, entities]
    - match:
        mime: ["text/*"]
      features: []
    - match:
        space_type: ["project"]
        mime: ["*"]
      features: [meta, entities, summary]
EOF
echo "written"; cat /workspace/taki-config.yaml | head -5
